quarterly_data.quarter: Kokusai Electric semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-11-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 (April - September 2025) revenue JPY 117.2 billion (up 2.3% year on year). Management states sales of DRAM equipment to Chinese local makers and of legacy equipment (in the service business), concentrated in the prior-year half, settled down, while NAND equipment sales, Logic/Foundry equipment sales to Chinese local makers and large upgrade modifications of DRAM equipment for non-China makers grew. Operating profit JPY 22.7 billion (down 17.2%) and profit attributable to owners of the parent JPY 15.6 billion (down 13.8%) on product mix and up-front R&D; adjusted operating profit JPY 25,341 million (prior-year half JPY 30,681 million).
quarterly_data.figure: H1 revenue JPY 117.2 billion (+2.3%); operating profit JPY 22.7 billion (-17.2%); adjusted OP JPY 25,341 million (from JPY 30,681 million)

quarterly_data.quarter: Kokusai Electric semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-11-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 revenue by customer location (prior-year half in brackets): China JPY 55,000 million (JPY 57,327 million), Korea JPY 22,369 million (JPY 15,905 million), Taiwan JPY 20,512 million (JPY 18,385 million), Japan JPY 10,877 million (JPY 10,157 million), United States JPY 3,314 million (JPY 6,867 million); total JPY 117,205 million (JPY 114,548 million). Product sales JPY 73,238 million (JPY 75,333 million) and service sales JPY 43,967 million (JPY 39,215 million). Property, plant and equipment rose JPY 3.3 billion in the half, mainly on investment for the US demo center.
